purpose: Mandatory per-scenario regression gate for Korean preparation, shop, hiring, class, and commander labels

required_checks_per_scenario.description: Before entering the shop, inspect every page of the allied, NPC, and enemy commander roster; verify every commander name and class label.
Before entering the shop, inspect every commander hiring page and every offered mercenary row; verify every mercenary name and the surrounding commander/class labels.
Enter the shop, open at least one buy or item-detail surface, leave the shop, and return to preparation without restarting or loading a state.
After the same-run shop round trip, inspect every page of the allied, NPC, and enemy commander roster again; verify every commander name and class label.
After the same-run shop round trip, inspect every commander hiring page and every offered mercenary row again; verify every mercenary name.
Where available, inspect class-change choices and commander status labels for all visible characters and classes.
For every capture, verify the full screen: Korean text, unit sprites, gray acted sprites, minimap, tile rows, borders, and numerical fields must all remain intact.

evidence_rules.release_gate: No localization or hard-mode release may be declared verified while any required scenario/check remains pending or failed.

known_failure_evidence.failure: Gray Hangul-like blocks overwrite result/summary sprites.
Commander and mercenary labels contain gray blocks and the right minimap is row-shifted.
